datasets.name: PHM 2016 CMP Data Challenge
datasets.note: Sensors and outcome on the same wafers. Used by predict_removal_rate.

datasets.name: WM-811K (LSWMD)
datasets.note: Real maps, real labels. Used standalone by classify_wafer_map — the classifier itself involves no constructed pairing.

datasets.name: SECOM (UCI id=179)
datasets.note: Real readings, anonymised channels, no fault labels — so it can validate detection but not root-cause attribution.

datasets.name: YieldGuard demo lots
datasets.note: SECOM rows paired with WM-811K maps BY US. Each component is real; the join is not. Retained because CMP has no wafer maps and so cannot carry the vision or root-cause demo.

data_provenance.rule: Entities carry a data_provenance block. 'measured' means the sensor-to-outcome link exists in the source data. 'constructed' means we joined unrelated real datasets and no causal claim survives the join.

results.top_hypothesis: Slurry flow rate drift caused by a degrading slurry pump on CMP-03
results.evidence: Historical case HC-018, sensor_12 (z-score=-2.4), and equipment telemetry parameter slurry_flow_rate showing a declining trend over the last 6 lots

results.top_hypothesis: Degrading slurry pump on CMP-03 causing flow rate drift
results.evidence: Telemetry parameter slurry_flow_rate on CMP-03 is declining steadily (magnitude_sigma=-2.4) and historical case HC-018 shows identical failure mode

results.top_hypothesis: Incoming slurry vendor lot with out-of-spec viscosity causing center defect pattern
results.evidence: case_id=HC-024 (similarity=1.00) and sensor_91 z-score=+1.7 indicating viscosity deviation with no hardware failure.

results.top_hypothesis: RF power edge effect and gas flow distribution imbalance following chamber PM reassembly
results.evidence: HC-033, sensor_23 (+2.8 z-score), sensor_24 (+2.2 z-score), and ETCH-07 telemetry parameters rf_power_w and gas_flow_sccm

results.top_hypothesis: Partially clogged edge gas nozzle or edge zone flow distribution imbalance causing Edge-Ring defect pattern
results.evidence: Historical case HC-035 (similarity=1.00), telemetry parameter gas_flow_sccm decreasing with magnitude_sigma=-2.1, and sensors sensor_31, sensor_32, sensor_33 showing significant deviation.

results.top_hypothesis: Chamber wall seasoning drift after a shared-tool recipe change
results.evidence: Edge-Ring defect pattern matched with historical case HC-038 and chamber_seasoning_idx drifting in equipment telemetry.

results.top_hypothesis: Wafer-handling robot end-effector wear causing physical scratches due to high cycle count exceeding the maintenance limit.
results.evidence: HANDLER-01 end_effector_cycles at 48k cycles (past the 40k guideline), scratch defect pattern, and historical case HC-042/HC-044.

results.top_hypothesis: Wafer-handling robot end-effector wear causing physical scratch defects
results.evidence: Scratch defect pattern, all process sensors quiet (|z-score| < 0.5), historical case HC-042, and handler_01 end_effector_cycles at 48k cycles exceeding the 40k guideline.

results.top_hypothesis: Wafer-handling robot end-effector wear causing physical scratches without process sensor anomalies
results.evidence: Scratch defect pattern, HANDLER-01 end_effector_cycles at 48k (past the 40k guideline), and all process sensors having near-zero z-scores (sensor_87=0.2, sensor_12=0.0, sensor_45=0.0)

results.top_hypothesis: Stepper lens thermal drift tracking ambient fab temperature causing radial overlay and focus variation
results.evidence: Historical case HC-051 and telemetry parameter lens_temp_c showing increasing trend with magnitude_sigma=2.0 on LITHO-02

results.top_hypothesis: Reticle contamination introduced during a reticle swap leading to donut defect pattern
results.evidence: Historical case HC-053 shows similarity=1.00 for reticle contamination, supported by deviating sensor_63 (+2.6 z-score) and sensor_64 (+2.3 z-score) on LITHO-02.

results.top_hypothesis: Stepper lens thermal drift tracking ambient fab temperature swings affecting overlay and radial focus distribution
results.evidence: equipment LITHO-02 parameter lens_temp_c showing increasing trend with magnitude_sigma=2.0 and similar historical case HC-051

results.top_hypothesis: HEPA filter degradation in FILTER-B12 causing cleanroom particle count increase leading wafer defects
results.evidence: HC-061 similarity 1.00 and telemetry parameter filter_b12: particle_count_per_m3 magnitude_sigma=2.3 and hepa_runtime_hours=31k

results.top_hypothesis: Equipment hardware issue related to Etch chamber RF power oscillation and gas flow drift following recent PM
results.evidence: ETCH-07 parameter rf_power_w magnitude_sigma=2.8 and historical case HC-063

failures: none of ['maintenance', 'entry', 'access', 'contamination'] appeared; model said: "HEPA filter degradation leading to particle accumulation and random wafer defects"
results.top_hypothesis: HEPA filter degradation leading to particle accumulation and random wafer defects
results.evidence: Historical case HC-061, FILTER-B12 particle_count_per_m3 parameter showing increasing trend (magnitude_sigma=2.3) and hepa_runtime_hours at 31k hours past the 28k guideline.

results.top_hypothesis: Equipment hardware failure in CMP process step cascading through the system
results.evidence: case_id=HC-071 and telemetry parameter slurry_flow_rate showing declining trend with magnitude_sigma=-2.4

results.top_hypothesis: Equipment interlock software bug or route mismatch misrouted wafers
results.evidence: sensor_route_mismatch z-score is +2.7, process sensors are quiet (sensor_12=0.3, sensor_45=0.2), and historical case HC-074 matches this exact failure signature.

results.top_hypothesis: Test head calibration drift and contact resistance increase causing systematic false failures across probe channels
results.evidence: sensor_tester_01 z-score=+3.1, historical cases HC-077 and HC-079, and telemetry parameters test_head_calibration_drift and contact_resistance_ohm
